title: Returns and refunds
goal: Show a retail return from eligibility through inspection and customer resolution.

rubric.must: An ineligible return visibly routes from the eligibility decision to a Reject return terminator.
The inspection decision visibly separates restocking from scrap-or-recycle handling.
A customer-request decision visibly separates replacement shipment from refund processing.
A failed refund acceptance branch visibly enters payment investigation and loops back to refund processing.
The eligible path visibly includes issuing a return label and receiving the returned item before inspection.
Restock inventory is visibly distinguished as a storage-style node.
